description: Prompts the deterministic router misroutes today. Not counted as routing coverage. Each must keep reproducing its recorded misroute; when a routing fix makes one pass, tooling/routing_coverage.py --check fails until it is moved into suite.json.

cases.prompt: Roadmap for the next release before production: what should we fix this week?
cases.reason: A this-week time box is weekly control, but repo-to-roadmap's 'roadmap ... before production' signal (12) outscores product-operator's 'what should we fix this week' (10). A generic 'this week' boost for product-operator broke the deliberate near-tie in test_near_tie_multi_intent_does_not_collapse_to_one_specialist, so it was not added.
